meta.note: P2 triage complete: 6 already-fixed, 5 fix-now, 7 defer-p2, 0 false-positive. Deferred items require fleet, sandbox, agent-policy, or coverage-baseline design work outside this patch.

findings.title: PR code now runs on self-hosted EC2 CI lanes

validation.rationale: Pull-request jobs execute repository-controlled code on owned runners. The durable fix is the one-job-one-VM ephemeral cutover, not a workflow-only gate in PR-editable content.

findings.title: Non-ephemeral CI runners expose PR jobs to trusted push secrets

validation.rationale: Reusable burst runners can persist state from an untrusted PR job into a later trusted push job. Isolation requires JIT ephemeral runners and separated trust lanes.

findings.title: PR code now runs on owned EC2 CI runners

validation.rationale: This is the same untrusted-PR-on-owned-runner boundary as CSF-001 on additional lanes. The fleet cutover must remove persistence and worker credentials structurally.

findings.title: Shadow runner exposes AWS role creds to job code

validation.rationale: Host-process job steps can reach instance metadata even though container probes cannot. The fix belongs in bootstrap identity removal or host-level IMDS isolation during the ephemeral cutover.

findings.title: Yeet PR footer leaks local paths and AI session IDs

validation.rationale: Merged PR #650 tokenizes the configured home prefix before PR provenance is rendered, so the private home path reported by this finding is absent on current HEAD.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/yeet-pr-provenance.test.ts

findings.title: LLM title data can break out of JSDoc comments

validation.rationale: Model-provided titles and see-purpose text were decoded as unrestricted strings before direct JSDoc interpolation.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/jsdoc-migrate.test.ts

findings.title: Shadow CI runners can be triggered by default labels

validation.rationale: Merged PR #649 sets bidirectional label matching and disables default runner labels; the Pulumi update was applied.

findings.title: JSDoc title tool can leak API tokens to arbitrary proxy URLs

validation.rationale: A caller-controlled proxy URL received the first available provider credential without destination validation.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/jsdoc-migrate.test.ts

findings.title: Agent friction logging can leak secrets into public ledgers

validation.rationale: AGENTS.md now requires secret redaction, home-path tokenization, session identifier removal, and minimal error excerpts before a friction receipt is tracked.

verificationCommands: rg -n 'redact secrets|absolute home paths|session/machine ids' AGENTS.md

findings.title: Unescaped branch names in sweep handoff commands

validation.rationale: Rendered Git refs and branch operands now pass through the shared shell-quoting helper, including operator handoffs.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/yeet-sweep-plan.test.ts

findings.title: Semantic-delta probes execute untrusted archive code

validation.rationale: Current code skips fork pull-request probes, but same-repository and local scans still execute archive-local modules. Removing that class requires a non-executing probe design or an explicit sandbox boundary.

findings.title: Agent configs disable sandbox and approval safeguards

validation.rationale: Current configuration still selects unrestricted Codex defaults and a broad GitHub CLI grant. Both implicated config surfaces are policy-owned and edit-protected in this session, so a one-sided patch would be incomplete.

findings.title: Git option injection via fleet origin URL

validation.rationale: The resolved origin URL was passed after Git options without an option terminator in both remote probe commands.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/worktree-fleet-scan.test.ts

findings.title: Hook-pulse disarm can falsely succeed without disabling hooks

validation.rationale: Any failed hard-link publish was treated as an existing effective sentinel, including a dangling symlink that the writer does not observe.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/library/ai-metrics && bunx --bun vitest run test/hook-pulse-writer.test.ts

findings.title: Missing closeout artifact marks PR merge-ready

validation.rationale: Merge readiness now requires a present closeout artifact before thread and issue counts can satisfy the gate.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/yeet-status-triage.test.ts

findings.title: Raw GitHub job names in TSV enable spreadsheet injection

validation.rationale: TSV string cells are normalized to one line and formula-leading values are prefixed so spreadsheet imports treat them as text.

verificationCommands: cd packages/tooling/tool/cli && bunx --bun vitest run test/ci-lane-timings.test.ts

findings.title: Candor gate can release unrelated superseded AI citations

validation.rationale: Supersession checked only event identity and source digest, allowing a different patent reference in the same source group to retire the gated citation.

verificationCommands: cd packages/law-practice/use-cases && bunx --bun vitest run test/CandorPolicy.test.ts

findings.title: Coverage ratchet can miss offset test regressions

validation.rationale: Package-level percentage and uncovered totals cannot distinguish offsetting deletions from lost coverage. Closing the gap requires a per-file baseline redesign rather than a local predicate tweak.
